name: @epoch/procurement
description: Epoch Procurement kernel (W037) — resource acquisition as the universal acquisition layer, with procurement/supplier delivery as the concrete construction/commercial projection of @epoch/solution-delivery's Acquire contract (W036): typed content-addressed requirement-to-acquisition-package lineage (one requirement fans out to many acquisition attempts); provider-neutral quotes/offers/allocations with selection as a RECORDED, hash-chained decision referencing exact quote digests (a selection not backed by a live quote digest is dangling-quote-rejected); commitment linkage through W036 Commitment-distinction records (created/linked, never re-implemented); sealed version-chained purchase orders (previousPOVersionDigest, the W023 convention); the supplier-delivery state machine (ordered -> confirmed -> shipped/partial -> received -> accepted|rejected|disputed) with append-only transitions and accumulating partial receipts linked to W036 DeliveryRecord observation intake; substitution requests whose acceptance REQUIRES a constraint-evaluation reference (W004 policy shapes, opaque digest — otherwise unevaluated-substitution-rejected); typed lead-time observations (Prediction/Estimate distinction references with mandatory uncertainty, never a bare number); and acquisition status as a sealed derived-only projection. Provider-neutral supplier identity (opaque ids, never vendor names in core types). NO persistence, NO UI, NO provider vocabulary.
